housing.summary: Numbeo reported EUR 766.67 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Parma city centre in August 2026; Immobiliare.it has a dedicated Parma bilocal-rental listing page. A Parma-specific deposit norm was not located.

banking.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo states that opening its online current account requires a valid identity document and an Italian tax code; a valid health card can serve as the tax-code document.
required_docs: Valid identity card, driving licence, or passport
Italian tax code (codice fiscale), or a valid health card as the tax-code document

schools.summary: Scuola per l'Europa in Parma is accredited to follow European Schools curricula from nursery through European Baccalaureate level, with Italian, English, and French language sections.

legal_admin.summary: People arriving from abroad who establish their habitual residence in Parma must register it with the municipal registry; applications are submitted through the Comune di Parma online service or with support at the DUC counter.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit the residence-registration declaration to the Comune di Parma after actually moving to the Parma address.

tax_finance.summary: The Italian tax ID is the codice fiscale. Foreign nationals receive it through the Immigration Desk for qualifying entry applications or through the Questura for residence-permit applications; people without one may apply using form AA4/8, with first issuance to foreign nationals requiring an in-person appointment for identification.

transport.summary: TEP S.p.A. operates Parma public transport, and its ordinary personal urban monthly pass costs EUR 39 for a calendar month. Foreign-licence rules depend on the issuing jurisdiction and reciprocity. Eligible newcomers register for the SSN through the CUP office for their Parma health district.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences are treated as Italian and generally remain valid until expiry; licences without an EU-compliant expiry must be converted after two years of Italian residence. Non-EU/EEA licence holders may drive for up to one year after acquiring Italian residence with an international permit or official Italian translation; after that, conversion is available only where a reciprocity agreement exists, otherwise an Italian licence must be obtained by examination.
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible EU citizens present documentation proving entitlement at the CUP office for their district of residence. Eligible extra-EU citizens present an identity document, a residence permit or proof that issuance or renewal is pending, and a self-certification of residence at the CUP office for their district; registration includes choosing a family doctor or paediatrician.
